title: Kula Today
heading: Today
summary: Cloudbase is at its highest of the day and still edging up. Kula Ag had mostly sun over the last hour. Upslope has run since about 07:45 at a light 2 mph, and thermals seem flat. Trades are holding the shear line crossing Kula Highway between Pukalani and Kamehameha Schools, with no trade air on the lower west slope.
